notes: hud.goal is still the English source "Divide: {cur}/{need}". Fix: "Dividir: {cur}/{need}".
eaten "Presas" means prey, not Eaten. dEaten "Comido" is already the right death-cause word. Fix: "Comidos".
hud.divide.reason.cd "recarga" reads as ammo reload, not cooldown. Fix: "espera {sec} s".
resume "SEGUIR" means follow or go on, not resume. Fix: "REANUDAR" (8 chars; fine on a menu button).
toast.cyst.enter "movimiento 0" breaks the speed term (simSpeed is "Velocidad"). Fix: "Espora: protegida, velocidad 0, la energía baja despacio".
vignette "Viñeta" also means a comic panel. Fix: "Viñeteado".
Do not abbreviate DIVIDIR or REINICIAR, and do not merge espora with enquistaste. Those are already the shortest accurate forms and the right spore/cyst split.
restart "फिर से" means again, not restart. Fix: "फिर शुरू" (or "रीस्टार्ट" if the button must stay one token).
dStarve "भूख" is hunger and collides with toast.cyst.hunger. Starved is a death cause. Fix: "भुखमरी". Keep बीजाणु for spore and सिस्ट for encysted.
toast.cyst.enter "सुरक्षा" means security, not protected. Fix: "बीजाणु: सुरक्षित, गति 0, ऊर्जा धीरे घटती है".
toast.divide.go "विभाजन" is the noun, not Dividing. The busy reason already says the action is in progress. Fix: "बाँट रहा है".
selectSp "जीव चुनें" is polite while toasts and buttons use तुम (तुम पौधे हो, खाओ, तैरो). Fix: "जीव चुनो". Leave help "कैसे खेलें" — that is the usual title, not an आप address.
menuSub "अनुप्रस्थ काट" is textbook Hindi on the title line. Fix: "सूक्ष्मजीव सिमुलेशन — 100 प्रजातियाँ + वायरस। तालाब का क्रॉस-सेक्शन।".
Button length: close "बंद करो" and resume "जारी रखो" are two words. Fix: "बंद" and "जारी".
wikiT "göl" means lake; menuSub already uses the pond word "Gölet". Fix: "Viki: gölet yaşamı".
toast.cyst.enter "hareket 0" breaks the speed term (simSpeed is "Hız"). Fix: "Spor: korumalı, hız 0, enerji yavaş azalır".
toast.eat.none drops swim; the plant toast keeps "yüz". Fix: "Yakında av yok — daha yakına yüz".
restart "YENİDEN" means again. Fix: "BAŞTAN".

Length: dead "NESLİ TÜKENDİ" (13) vs EXTINCT (7); paused "DURAKLATILDI" (12) vs PAUSED (6). Fix: "YOK OLDU" and "DURAKLADI". Do not lengthen the HUD verbs OTO, SPOR, BÖL, YE, IŞIK, and do not merge spor with kist.
maxPop "Azami" is stiffer than the rest of the file. Fix: "Maks. nüfus".
autoOn is "オート" but hud.btn.auto and hud.btn.auto.short are "自動". Same AUTO control. Fix: "オート" on all three.
diffE "易しい" is not the usual difficulty label. Fix: "簡単".
resume "続ける" means keep going; a pause-menu Resume is "再開". Fix: "再開".
toast.eat.none drops swim; the plant toast keeps "泳げ". Fix: "近くに獲物がいない — もっと泳いで近づけ".
Do not merge 胞子 with シスト, or 飢餓 with 空腹, and do not replace 速度. Those distinctions already match spore/cyst, starved/hunger, and speed.
